critique: The note proves the advertised matched-order oracle frontier: both the converse and score-inversion achievability yield min{1,t_0^{-1/2}}, including uniformly bounded constants on each fixed admissible geometry. It also proves a genuine feasible matched-order result when target weights are learned, but only for finite cells with known regular source probabilities and known propensities. The result is order-sharp rather than constant-sharp, applies only to fixed strength thresholds, and does not establish feasible inference for unknown propensities or continuous covariates. These restrictions keep the contribution at field level rather than flagship, but the TL;DR, project justification, and honest-scope prose do not claim those unresolved extensions as proved.
